Politics · India

Train halted on tracks for passenger to buy snacks

A train was halted on the tracks in a busy area after a passenger asked to get off to buy snacks. The incident occurred when a Lok Sabha member of the ruling party got off the train and stopped it, causing a delay. The video of the incident has gone viral. The railway authorities have started an investigation into the matter.
